tips.text: Use () to describe actions, feelings, and thoughts to make the chat more immersive.
Try adjusting “Chat Style” in chat settings to change the tone or writing style.
Tap the heart icon on a character to save them to Favorites for quick access.
Earn Boost Points by chatting, generating images, listening to voices, or checking in daily.
Tap the + button to access voice call and have real-time conversations with your characters.
When reporting issues, upload a screenshot to help us understand and fix the problem faster.
